Dear prado team,

I am writing to apply for the Front-end Developer (Shopify) position. With a strong foundation in front-end development and hands-on experience building and optimizing websites, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to prado's e-commerce growth.

In my current role at Episto, I build and maintain WordPress sites, focusing on performance and user experience. Previously, as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. I am proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and I have experience with Git. I am eager to apply my skills to Shopify, and I am a quick learner, ready to master Liquid and Shopify's ecosystem.

I am fluent in English and have a B1 level in Dutch, currently improving. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and can work hybrid from Ghent.

I would love to discuss how my technical skills and attention to detail can benefit prado. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear prado team,

I am excited to apply for the Front-end Developer (Shopify) position. With a solid background in front-end development and a passion for creating seamless, high-performing web experiences, I am eager to contribute to prado's innovative e-commerce platforms.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I build and maintain client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and the Astra theme. This hands-on experience has honed my skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and taught me the importance of site performance and user experience. Previously, as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript, giving me a strong foundation in modern front-end practices.

While my professional experience has been primarily with WordPress, I am a fast learner and have already started exploring Shopify's Liquid and Online Store 2.0 architecture. I am confident in my ability to quickly master Shopify's theme development, sections, and APIs. My attention to detail and design sensibility, honed through building my own project mirook.com, will allow me to translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect code.

I am particularly drawn to prado's mission of creating invisible home technology for architects. The opportunity to work across multiple brands and contribute to the prado 2.0 integration is thrilling. I am comfortable working independently and switching between content updates and larger features, and I am fluent in English with a working knowledge of Dutch (B1, currently improving).

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my technical skills and enthusiasm can support prado's e-commerce growth. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
